tex_content.source:
\label{sec:laplace-dirichlets-principle}

Define
$$I[w]=\int_U\left(\frac12|Dw|^2-wf\right)dx,
\qquad
\mathcal A=\{w\in C^2(\overline U):w=g\text{ on }\partial U\}.$$
